annotations.title: Browse my bookmarked movies and shows

description: Use for my bookmarks, my watchlist, saved movies or shows, did I save this title, and help me pick from my list. Lists the connected viewer's own saves, newest first; query searches the full list by title fragment, kind filters movies or shows, and next_offset retrieves another page. Start a simple browse with the default page and a short linked list; show remaining fetched titles before fetching more when requested or when it helps choose. matched_count is the total for the applied filters. If a movie/show breakdown is requested, use kind-filtered counts rather than estimating it. Returns saved dates, descriptions, genres, subgenres, tags, runtime, ReelRecs links and audience scores. With personal recommendation permission, also adds Your Rec Score predictions. Keep picks within the returned bookmarks when requested, check watch options, and curate a few fitting choices using available returned title links. Rated or watched titles can still be bookmarked; do not infer history or likes from a save. Requires bookmarks:read permission. Cannot read another account or add/remove saves.

limit.description: Saved titles per page. Usually retrieve twelve to help choose; request more when listing bookmarks.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous page to see more saved titles.
offset.title: Offset

query.description: Optional title name or fragment to search within the viewer's bookmarks. Empty lists recent saves.
